x: His team-mates O'Connor and Mann were always well placed but couldn't match the second half running of Ealing's Warren and Case. Colin Pearson produced a very good debut at 20 miling and was rewarded with the Newcomer's prize and a third place team medal in the Surrey Championship.
With the exception of Warren Lynch, however, the conditions took their toll on our lads over the second circuit with Joachim encountering stomach problems and Rob and Jerome drifting back somewhat.

They took us out by just 19 seconds; but Mal, me and Warren can have no regrets as we squeezed every second out of the course. Our respective splits for the final 2.2 k were: 7:57, 7:59 and a remarkable 8:00 for Warren – comfortably placing us all in the speediest 25 runners for that stretch of macadam.
